title: Status badges are distinguishable without relying on color alone
preconditions: The fleet dashboard with connectors in multiple statuses
steps: View the page with a color-blindness simulation filter applied
Confirm each status badge's text label is legible independent of its color
expectedResult: Pending/Online/Offline/Revoked are each identifiable by their text label, not color alone.

title: The Register Connector modal is fully operable via keyboard only
preconditions: Logged in as a user with vtec.create
steps: Open the modal using only the keyboard (Tab/Enter)
Tab to the TTL input, the Issue button, and the copy-to-clipboard button
expectedResult: Every control is reachable and operable via keyboard alone, with a visible focus indicator at each step; the modal can be closed via keyboard (Escape) as well.

title: Credential form inputs have correct autocomplete/type attributes and accessible labels
preconditions: Logged in as a user with vtec.create
steps: Inspect the Value input's type and autocomplete attributes
Confirm each FormControl's FormLabel is programmatically associated with its input
expectedResult: The value field is type="password" with autoComplete="new-password" (never pre-filled or auto-suggested from browser history); a screen reader announces each field's label correctly.

title: The cert-expiry stat card exposes its urgency via text, not color alone
preconditions: A connector with a certificate expiring within 24 hours
steps: View the connector detail page's Certificate Expiry card with a screen reader / color simulation
expectedResult: The card's text ('Xh remaining', 'Expired') conveys urgency on its own, independent of the red/orange/green color coding.
